bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH WEDNESDAY EVENING... Combined seas 13 to 16 ft continuing through the overnight. Bar conditions rough becoming severe late this evening. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 445 PM Tuesday, 530 AM Wednesday. and 530 PM Wednesday. The afternoon ebb on Tuesday and Wednesday will be strong.
